name: 孙烨
intro: I am a PhD student in Software Engineering at the School of Computer Science and Engineering, Beihang University, in an integrated master’s–PhD program. I expect to graduate in June 2027. My research focuses on knowledge graph reasoning, data mining, and visual analytics.

education.title: Beihang University · Computer Science and Technology
education.text: Bachelor of Engineering, School of Computer Science and Engineering. GPA: 3.67/4.00; major-course scores include Mathematical Analysis (100), Software Engineering (98), and Deep Learning (94).

education.title: Beihang University · Computer Science and Technology
education.text: Integrated master’s–PhD program, School of Computer Science and Engineering. Master’s stage: Sep 2021–Jun 2023; PhD stage: Sep 2023–Jun 2027 (expected). GPA: 3.87/4.00; rank: 13/143. Major-course scores include Data Mining (100), Algorithm Design and Analysis (94), Software Engineering (95), and Pattern Recognition (93). Research focuses on knowledge graph reasoning, data mining, and visual analytics; related results have appeared in multiple CCF-A papers.

research.title: eXpath · Explainable knowledge graph reasoning framework
research.summary: Addresses the black-box nature of embedding-model decisions by independently proposing an explanation framework that combines ontological closed-path rules and relational-path evidence.

research.title: RuleDep · Dependency-aware rule aggregation
research.summary: Leads the design of sparse second-order corrections and a two-stage training framework to model complementarity and redundancy in rule aggregation.

research.title: GeneticPrism · Hierarchical graph layout and scholarly evolution visualization
research.summary: Addresses the joint representation of within-topic citations and cross-topic influence in multi-topic scholarly evolution by proposing a hierarchical graph representation and IFHL layout.

research.title: INSPIRE · Expressive Piano Performance Generation
research.status: AAAI 2027, CCF-A · First author · Under review
research.summary: Builds a note-level structured performance-generation framework that generates expressive performances from discrete symbols through relative-timing modeling and continuous distribution prediction.

research.title: CueIR · Long-term agent memory
research.summary: Studies traceable memory organization and retrieval. Memory-graph construction and agent tools are operational, with evaluation on the LoCoMo and MemoryAgentBench datasets.

experience.title: MaterAgent · Agent Harness for materials R&D
experience.summary: Participates in Agent Harness architecture design for end-to-end materials R&D and builds the core framework supporting agent execution.

experience.title: Research-agent-based data classification
experience.summary: Developed LLM entity-extraction tools and a RAG-based data classification pipeline for sensitive-data annotation and refinement.
details: Contributed to the research-agent platform by integrating entity extraction, retrieval-augmented generation, and data classification. The team was named one of Beihang University’s Top Ten Outstanding Teams in Artificial Intelligence.

experience.title: GeneticFlow V2.0 · Large-scale scholarly literature visualization system
experience.summary: Leads development of a multidimensional visualization system for million-scale scholarly literature, integrating graph-layout computation with visual interaction.

experience.title: SenseTime · AI full-stack engineering intern
experience.summary: Contributed deeply to the Miaohua AI-drawing system, designing and implementing back-end APIs for efficient and stable core drawing calls.

experience.title: SenseTime · Model toolchain intern
experience.summary: Contributed to training-cluster scheduling toolchains and led development of the spring.remote command-line tool for remote cluster login and management, as well as system monitoring tools. Received an Outstanding Intern award.

experience.title: National Key R&D Program: Rare-earth catalysis knowledge graph and full-process digital R&D platform
experience.period: Sep 2021–Aug 2024 · National Key R&D Program subproject
experience.summary: Led construction of the database and materials knowledge graph, participating throughout the project from proposal to acceptance and ensuring scheduled delivery reviews.
